blocks.text:
Another local attraction is the ruined Garcia d’Ávila Castle.

Walking is a good way to enjoy a quiet day. Small fishermen’s houses surrounded by greenery still stand in the area. Beaches alternate with sand dunes, coconut groves and mangroves. From June to October, you may spot the dark backs of whales from the coast; during turtle season, the hatchlings’ journey to the ocean is a highlight.

These days have no fixed sightseeing programme, leaving you free to relax by the ocean, swim and choose your own activities.
